findings.namedBuyers: Alexandre Catton, EPHJ Director, and Céline Stadler, Deputy Director, are verified organizer contacts for commercial routing and partnership discussions. Neither is publicly established as the hotel-contract signatory. Hanna Bliesener, Project Manager, is an additional operational routing contact. Official shared route: contact.ephj@easyfairs.com, +41 61 228 10 30.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: 8–11 June 2027, Palexpo, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Dates are event activity dates, independently published by the organizer and venue, and reiterated in the 19 June 2026 closing release. Within the requested horizon. No official 2028 dates established in the reviewed sources.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied hotel specification: YOTEL is a conditional fit for a small slice of exhibitor, supplier or organizer-team lodging, potentially with briefings/F&B, not hosting the exhibition itself. Its 237 rooms and approximately 250-theatre meeting capacity cannot absorb this trade show. Test only a negotiated 20–120-room commercial band, not a demand forecast or whole-house assumption. Founex is outside the walkable venue cluster. The hotel advertises a free airport shuttle in morning/evening only, not pre-bookable and with no midday service; this is not a confirmed EPHJ or direct Palexpo shuttle. Dedicated show-hour transfers would need verification. This is business-travel demand, not a resort-retreat lead.
findings.venueCommitments: Palexpo is the announced 2027 exhibition venue, not a hotel. Territory classification: Geneva Airport corridor, in Le Grand-Saconnex, canton of Geneva; not Founex/Nyon/La Côte, downtown Geneva or Lausanne. The public listing verifies venue selection, not the underlying contract terms.
findings.historicalRotation: Not a rotating-destination conference: founded at Beaulieu in 2002; the documented move was from Lausanne to Palexpo Geneva in 2012. Verified edition anchors include 2011 Beaulieu Lausanne, 2012 Palexpo Geneva, and 2024–2026 Palexpo. Easyfairs explicitly committed in 2025 to preserve the Geneva location. Annual recurrence is stated, not inferred from a date pattern.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific 2027 pathway: organizer-negotiated partner rates through the Palexpo booking platform. Exact quote: “Take advantage of the rates negotiated by EPHJ with the Palexpo booking platform.” The 2027 page does not name the partner hotels or publish allotments, room nights, exclusivity, release dates or an open hotel RFP. Historical 2025 official partner promotion names every hotel in that promotion: Mövenpick; Adina; IntercityHotel; B&B. These are historical preferred-rate partners, not verified 2027 blocks or guaranteed bookings. Palexpo Hotel Reservation handles hotel requirements and pre-booked rooms; public contact info@palexpohotelreservation.ch, +41 (0)22 761 10 11. Supplier admission remains unconfirmed.
findings.organizationStructure: Commercial B2B exhibition owned by Easyfairs, not an association congress or corporate incentive meeting. Easyfairs announced the ownership transition on 4 June 2025 and continuation of the team led by Alexandre Catton. Palexpo is the venue; Palexpo Hotel Reservation is the published accommodation-booking pathway. No separate PCO or DMC mandate was established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The official 2027 accommodation proposition prioritizes hotels in immediate proximity to Palexpo. The historical 2025 partners were Mövenpick, Adina, IntercityHotel and B&B; the historical promotion specifically advertised Mövenpick’s Palexpo shuttle. Those preferences disadvantage a transfer-dependent Founex property. No sourced 2027 sell-out, overflow requirement, hotel exclusivity or guaranteed room allocation was found; none should be claimed.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Alexandre Catton and Céline Stadler via the published EPHJ team address; ask who manages the 2027 accommodation agreement and request an introduction to Palexpo Hotel Reservation. In parallel ask the reservation service whether Vaud/Founex properties can participate, whether the 2027 list is closed, and what commissions, allotments, cancellation/release terms and transfer standards apply. Only after those answers, propose a limited, demand-led allocation within the hotel’s supplied 20–120-room band with separately confirmed show-hour transport and optional team briefings/F&B. If 2027 participation is closed, request the next partner-contract review date without presenting 2028 as announced.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 venue is already selected and a hotel-booking pathway already exists. This is not evidence that all lodging is committed elsewhere, but it is also not evidence that hotel sourcing is open. YOTEL access is conditional on Palexpo Hotel Reservation supplier acceptance or independently sourced exhibitor/team business; no organizer block for YOTEL is established.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue repeat accommodation capture rather than venue displacement. Annual recurrence and the retained Geneva location support relationship development, but do not establish 2028 dates or available inventory. Seek inclusion in a future partner-rate programme or direct exhibitor/team accounts, supported by a costed transfer proposition. No sourced spillover need yet.
